followup_explanation:
This query is a benign creative/philosophical composition task with no harm-adjacent content, so the task-preference profiles (which only differentiate the two models on distasteful-but-permissible material) don't apply here. The deciding factor is raw capability.

Petrel-235B outscores Avocet-235B across the board on benchmarks relevant to this task — notably Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), MMLU-Pro (81.2 vs 74.8), and the internal Creative Generation eval (84.7 vs 78.8, a gap well above the 2.0-point variance threshold). Composing thoughtful instructions grounded in a specific philosopher's worldview rewards strong creative generation and broad knowledge, both of which favor Petrel.

So I routed to the stronger generalist model for what is essentially a high-quality writing task.
